horizon_convention.censoring: horizon equals last observed action count when all observed positive offsets remain valid
horizon_convention.definition: h* = max action count h such that Y_refresh(h-1) remains true

deviations.action_contract: relative Cartesian position plus axis-angle deltas, not joint positions
deviations.arm_signal: max(normalized translation RMS, normalized rotation RMS) per action
deviations.calibration: first 80 percent of episodes within each task, episode-level split
deviations.gripper_signal: normalized absolute gripper command per action; no direct PACE analog in source
deviations.threshold: per-task/per-group 5th percentile of positive calibration valley scores
deviations.valley_prominence: min(left-window maximum, right-window maximum) minus valley over a 10-step neighborhood
deviations.valley_selection: local minima, prominence-first nonmaximum suppression with minimum separation 10

source.status: PACE-style offline diagnostic, not a faithful PACE reproduction
